title: Hetero-Associative Visuomotor Memory: Soft Recall as a Base for Learned Residuals in Few-Demonstration Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieve-and-correct policies typically refine the nearest retrieved demonstration chunk, the   readout that works best when executed directly. We study what a demonstration memory should   supply to the corrector instead and find that a smooth, softmax-weighted recall over the whole   memory is a much better base. On ALOHA cube transfer (40 human demonstrations), soft recall is   no better to execute alone than the nearest chunk; however, with keys, candidates, and training   fixed, correcting it raises success by 22.4 points on fresh resets with new encoders and by 7.4   against a closed-loop-tuned top-1 corrector. On robomimic Square, it leads by 7.9 points with   the two better operators and by 6.7 on a label-free draw of equal size. This gain holds on   sparse, varied demonstrations under an action-aware key and leave-one-demonstration-out   training, and fades or slightly reverses on dense, scripted, or generated data. translated_title: 异联想视觉运动记忆：软召回作为少演示模仿中学习残差的基础
translated_abstract: 检索-修正策略通常对检索到的最近邻演示片段进行细化，这种读取方式在直接执行时效果最佳。我们研究了演示记忆应当向修正器提供什么内容，发现对整个记忆库进行平滑的、softmax加权的软召回是一个更好的基础。在ALOHA方块传递任务（40条人类演示）上，软召回单独执行时并不比最近邻片段更优；然而在键、候选和训练保持固定的情况下，对软召回进行修正，在使用新编码器的全新重置环境上成功率提升22.4个百分点，相比闭环调优的top-1修正器提升7.4个百分点。在robomimic Square任务上，配合两个更优的执行算子时领先7.9个百分点，在同等规模的无标签抽取数据上领先6.7个百分点。这一增益在稀疏、多样的演示场景下，采用动作感知键和留一演示法训练时依然成立，而在密集、脚本化或生成的数据上则减弱甚至略有逆转。
tldr: 研究发现，在少演示模仿的检索-修正框架中，让演示记忆提供对整个记忆库进行softmax加权的平滑软召回作为修正器的基底，相比传统修正最近邻检索片段的方式可显著提升策略成功率，且该优势在稀疏、多样的真实人类演示上最为突出。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that in retrieve-and-correct policies for few-demonstration imitation, supplying a smooth softmax-weighted soft recall over the entire demonstration memory as the corrector's base substantially improves success rates over refining the nearest retrieved chunk, with the advantage being most pronounced on sparse and varied human demonstrations.
